summary.name: Summary
summary.content: MSc student in Applied Computational Science & Engineering at Imperial College London and Founder of ReScience Lab, currently leading the development of an innovative canvas-based research platform designed to enhance research efficiency and inspire scientific innovation. Spearheading the creation of AI-powered tools that streamline the research workflow, from literature review to experimental design, while fostering collaborative interdisciplinary research. Combining deep technical expertise with entrepreneurial vision to transform how researchers conduct and share their work in the digital age.

items.name: E2M (Everything to Markdown)
items.description: Created an open-source Python library that converts various file types (doc, docx, epub, html, pdf, ppt, pptx, mp3, m4a) into Markdown format. The project has gained over 1,000 stars on GitHub and is widely used for preparing data for Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and model training.
highlights: Designed a modular parser-converter architecture for handling multiple file formats
Implemented Docker containerization for easy deployment
Built a RESTful API service for integration with other applications
Created comprehensive documentation and examples for users
items.summary: An open-source Python library for converting various file types to Markdown format with over 1,000 GitHub stars.

items.name: AI-Powered Presentation Generation Platform
items.description: Developed an innovative platform that leverages AI to automatically generate and customize PowerPoint presentations. The system utilizes LLMs and AI agents for content generation and styling, while implementing advanced CSS and frontend technologies for precise visual customization.
highlights: Architected an AI agent system that coordinates content generation, layout design, and style customization
Implemented LLM-driven CSS style generation for creating personalized presentation themes
Developed a dynamic frontend interface for real-time presentation preview and editing
Created an automated style recommendation system based on user preferences and presentation context
items.summary: An AI-powered platform that automates PowerPoint presentation creation with personalized styling and content generation capabilities.

items.score: Excellence in Modern Programming Methods & Computational Mathematics
items.summary: Key Modules: Modern Programming Methods (A*), Computational Mathematics (A*), Data Science and Machine Learning (B), Deep Learning: Machine Learning with Neural Networks (B)
Relevant Coursework: Advanced Mathematics, Signal Processing, Machine Learning, Data Structures

Founded ReScience Lab as a fourth venture, creating an interdisciplinary scientific platform that makes complex research workflows intuitive and reproducible. Leading the development of AI-powered tools for fields like bioinformatics and medical informatics, guided by principles of "freedom over growth, sustainability over speed, life over work."
highlights: Architected a canvas-based research platform designed to enhance research efficiency and inspire scientific innovation
Developed AI-powered research automation tools that streamline workflows from literature review to experimental design
Created an interdisciplinary collaboration framework fostering communication between different scientific fields
Implemented reproducible research practices ensuring transparency and reliability in scientific processes
Built specialized tools for bioinformatics and medical informatics applications

items.summary: Led a cross-functional team of 6 developers in developing an AI-powered PPT generation platform, focusing on personalized presentation creation through AI-generated styles.
highlights: Managed and coordinated a team of 6 frontend and backend developers to deliver an AI-powered presentation generation system
Architected and implemented AI-driven CSS style generation for personalized presentation themes
Led the development of user-centric PPT generation features that adapt to individual preferences and needs
Streamlined the development process and ensured efficient collaboration between frontend and backend teams

items.summary: Founded Wisup AI, leading its development with registered entities in the UK and China. Specializes in data processing tools and AI-driven research automation. Created the E2M library, achieving over 1,000+ GitHub stars.
highlights: Established a business presence in the UK and China
Developed the E2M library for file-to-Markdown conversion
Engineered a modular architecture for diverse parsers and converters
Implemented Docker-based solutions for streamlined installation
Authored detailed documentation and user examples

items.summary: Led development of AI-powered data processing and visualization solutions. (1) Webpage to Dataset: Developed a Python API that automatically converts webpages into structured datasets using LLMs, solving challenges in dataset traceability through AI agent-based self-reflection. (2) Dataset Auto Visualization: Created a full-stack web application using Python, DuckDB, and Streamlit for natural language data interaction, with an AI-powered field optimizer enabling text-to-SQL conversion for datasets with over 1,000 fields.

Developed data processing and analysis solutions for research papers. (1) Arxiv to Dataset: Created a system using NLP techniques and LLMs to extract relevant papers from arXiv based on user intent, achieving 98% data recall rate and 92% dataset accuracy. (2) Full Stack App: Built both frontend and backend using Python, Langchain and Streamlit, successfully delivering a product prototype.
